name: ClickFraudFree
author: cffjerson

sections.description:
ClickFraudFree is a service-based plugin that helps website owners protect their traffic and advertising campaigns from fraudulent clicks, bots, and malicious users.

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the ClickFraudFree external service, which analyzes traffic patterns and detects invalid or fraudulent activity in real time.

⚠️ Important:
This plugin relies on a remote service and does not function without an active ClickFraudFree account.

How the service works

When enabled, the plugin sends limited traffic-related data to the ClickFraudFree servers for analysis. This allows the service to detect and prevent click fraud and invalid traffic.

The plugin may communicate with the following external server:

  • https://clickfraudfree.com

Data sent to the service

Depending on your configuration, the plugin may transmit the following data to the ClickFraudFree service:

  • Client ID (provided by the ClickFraudFree account)
  • Visitor IP address
  • HTTP referrer URL
  • Timestamp of the visit

No personally identifiable user data is collected intentionally beyond what is required for fraud detection.

Why this data is needed

This information is required to:
* Identify repeat or automated traffic
* Detect bot activity and click farms
* Prevent competitors from generating invalid ad clicks
* Protect advertising budgets and analytics accuracy

Account requirement

An active ClickFraudFree account is required to use this plugin.
You must sign up at https://clickfraudfree.com and obtain a Client ID.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload it manually.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the ClickFraudFree settings page.
  4. Enter your ClickFraudFree Client ID.
  5. Save the settings to enable the service connection.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

The plugin itself is free, but an active ClickFraudFree account is required.

Does this plugin contact external servers?

Yes. This plugin connects to the ClickFraudFree service at clickfraudfree.com to analyze traffic and detect fraudulent activity.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is designed to operate efficiently and minimizes impact on page performance.

Is user consent required?

Site administrators explicitly enable the service by activating the plugin and entering a valid Client ID.
